children: Next week, investors will closely monitor developments in the Middle East for any further disruptions to oil supplies.
The earnings calendar will also be busy, with major technology companies, including hyperscalers Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon, set to report results.

Monetary policy will be another key focus, with interest rate decisions due from the Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank, the Bank of Japan, the Bank of Canada, the Bank of Thailand and the Reserve Bank of New Zealand.

On the economic front, preliminary GDP figures for the US and the Eurozone will be released, alongside US PCE inflation data and preliminary inflation figures for major European economies, including Germany.
Investors will also assess Tokyo inflation and Australia's CPI data.
Political developments will remain in the spotlight, including the UK's Autumn Budget, China's Communist Party's fifth plenum, and elections in Brazil and Israel.

title: Week Ahead - Oct 26th
